<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/post.php';

if (!function_exists('yy_bootstrap_site')) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Wuhanyingyuan core plugin was not loaded.');
}

foreach (['hello-world' => 'post', 'sample-page' => 'page'] as $slug => $post_type) {
    $default_posts = get_posts([
        'post_type' => $post_type,
        'post_status' => 'any',
        'name' => $slug,
        'posts_per_page' => -1,
        'fields' => 'ids',
    ]);
    foreach ($default_posts as $default_post_id) {
        wp_delete_post((int) $default_post_id, true);
    }
}

$result = yy_bootstrap_site(true);
$rewrite_rules = get_option('rewrite_rules');
$has_news_rule = false;
foreach ((array) $rewrite_rules as $pattern => $query) {
    if (str_starts_with((string) $pattern, 'news/([^/]+)') && str_contains((string) $query, 'name=$matches[1]')) {
        $has_news_rule = true;
        break;
    }
}
if (!$has_news_rule) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Bootstrap did not persist the WordPress news permalink rule.');
}

$editor = get_user_by('login', 'editor');
if (!$editor) {
    $editor_id = wp_create_user('editor', 'editor-pass', 'editor@example.test');
    if (is_wp_error($editor_id)) {
        throw new RuntimeException($editor_id->get_error_message());
    }
    $editor = get_user_by('id', $editor_id);
}
$editor->set_role('yy_content_editor');

$publisher = get_user_by('login', 'publisher');
if (!$publisher) {
    $publisher_id = wp_create_user('publisher', 'publisher-pass', 'publisher@example.test');
    if (is_wp_error($publisher_id)) {
        throw new RuntimeException($publisher_id->get_error_message());
    }
    $publisher = get_user_by('id', $publisher_id);
}
$publisher->set_role('yy_publisher');

if (class_exists('WP_Application_Passwords')) {
    $existing_passwords = WP_Application_Passwords::get_user_application_passwords($publisher->ID);
    $known_app_password = 'playground-app-password';
    $has_known_password = false;
    foreach ($existing_passwords as $existing_password) {
        if (($existing_password['name'] ?? '') === 'Playground') {
            $has_known_password = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!$has_known_password) {
        add_filter('random_password', static function () {
            return '0123456789abcdef01234567';
        });
        $created = WP_Application_Passwords::create_new_application_password(
            $publisher->ID,
            ['name' => 'Playground']
        );
        remove_all_filters('random_password');
        if (is_wp_error($created)) {
            throw new RuntimeException($created->get_error_message());
        }
        $known_app_password = $created[0];
    }
    update_option('yy_playground_app_password', $known_app_password, false);
}

update_option('yy_playground_bootstrap_result', $result, false);
